'''Cargo tubes''' were a device used in shipping. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Arwen Cohl]] and a group of mercenaries hid inside six two meter tall cargo tubes to smuggle themselves onto the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]].

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Cargo tubes appeared in the [[2001]] novel ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="COD" />
